text:
reem: kicking off BeaconLedger LoRA onboarding. pushed quick-eval pack to staging (job 4891). dataset is reimbursement tables + mixed currencies; watch tokenization around parentheses and thousand separators.
ted: plan: fp16 -> int8 -> int4, capture QA_F1, exact_match, token_robustness, avg_latency. ETA ~90m.
noor: uploaded small probe /evals/beaconledger/amounts-and-commas.json (28 samples) covering commas, spaces, currency prefixes and parens. flagged on job.
ci-bot: job 4891 scheduled: int8 run on gpu-dedicated-3 (ETA 8m).
noor: fp16 baseline local: QA_F1=0.851, exact_match=0.68, token_robustness=0.96, latency=73ms.
ted: int8 staging done: QA_F1=0.846, exact_match=0.66, token_robustness=0.94, latency=58ms. probe failures: 4/28 mostly comma+currency glue.
reem: example fail?
ted: sample: "Refund: USD 1,250" -> model returned "USD1,250" (no space). checker flags it. looks like token merge after quant.
noor: suggestion: add scoring-only canonicalizer that normalizes numeric punctuation and enforces spacing before currency codes. low risk. also dump token ids for failures to s3://redwood-debug/beacon/4891/fails.log for audit.
ci-bot: int4 run queued on node gpu-small-5 (ETA 12m).
reem: decision: int8 as canary, int4 behind experimental flag. implement canonicalizer in eval harness, emit failure tokenids, and add a smoke script for reproducing locally. owners: ted->quant runs & metrics, noor->probe curation & token dumps, reem->rollout note.
ted: PR created: eval: add numeric punctuation canonicalizer (scoring only) + tokenid logging. smoke command added: `python tools/smoke_repro.py --model beacon --sample 4 --quant int4`
noor: after canonicalizer: int8 QA_F1=0.848, probe fails 1/28. int4 QA_F1=0.827, probe fails 3/28. canonicalizer reduced false negatives by ~70%. token dumps uploaded.
reem: great. plan: run canary int8 tonight, keep int4 shadow behind flag. CI alert: block promotion if token_robustness drops >1% on probe set. will draft release notes clarifying canonicalizer is scoring-only. closing loop unless new fails surface. thanks team :party:
